basics.name: Kevin Vo
basics.summary: Mathematics–Computer Science student at UC San Diego focused on robotics, machine learning, and autonomous systems.

work.name: University of California, San Diego
work.summary: Integrated and validated autonomous drone perception and navigation systems.
highlights: Integrated an autonomous drone software stack on a Jetson Orin Nano using ROS 2, connecting the flight controller with onboard perception (detection + segmentation), survey mission planning, and real-time telemetry/logging.
Tested perception and navigation pipelines in Gazebo simulation to validate behavior before flight and reduce hardware debugging time.

work.name: FIRST Robotics Team 2710 Jetstream
work.summary: Led robotics software development for competition performance and reliability.
highlights: Developed drivetrain, autonomous, and mechanism control software for competitive play.
Led development of the Java-based robot software stack and introduced simulation for pre-hardware testing and faster iteration.
Built simulation + hardware-in-the-loop validation pipelines, accelerating bring-up and improving software reliability.
Implemented FOC on drivetrain motors, increasing torque by 34% and power by 25%, improving overall drivetrain responsiveness and performance.
Engineered autonomous and teleop control integrating trajectory planning and vision-based odometry fusion, contributing to a 3rd-place regional finish.

portfolio.name: Reinforcement Learning Robotics Project
portfolio.description: Built a physics-accurate Isaac Lab reinforcement learning environment inspired by competitive robotics tasks, modeling structured game field, swerve-based robot dynamics, and mechanism constraints in Isaac Sim. Defined state/action spaces and reward functions for drivetrain and mechanism control in a realistic physics-based simulation.

portfolio.name: CivicGrid
portfolio.description: Led a 3-person team building a voice-to-work-order system where users speak to an AI voice agent that generates structured reports with priority scores and routes them for contractor assignment. Built an ML pipeline that used Claude to convert conversational audio transcripts from a voice agent into structured YAML work orders with consistent fields, then stored them in a database.

portfolio.name: AI Robotics Service Dog
portfolio.description: Led a 3-person team developing a low-cost AI robotic service dog for visually impaired users, training a YOLOv7 model on 6,000+ labeled images for obstacle detection and hazard alerts. Awarded Intel Global AI for Accessibility and Country/Region awards.
